source: base/KH3.exe (image base 0x140000000) and build/decomp/*.jsonl; every hexadecimal value is a virtual address in the executable
how: type name string -> registration (static initializer) -> ConstructSerializedType -> vtable -> Serialize at vtable+0x10 -> the serializer calls it makes, flattened to primitives with the member offset each one fills

param.layout: FShaderParameter: uint16 at +2, uint16 at +4, uint16 at +0 (stock names BaseIndex, NumBytes, BufferIndex)

res.layout: FShaderResourceParameter: uint16 at +0, uint16 at +2 (stock names BaseIndex, NumResources)

ub.layout: FShaderUniformBufferParameter: uint16 at +4, 32-bit bool at +6 (stock names BaseIndex, bIsBound)

vfref.layout: FName vertex factory type (1431D21B0), uint8 shader frequency, 20-byte hash (142D99970), int32 file offset of the end of the parameters, then the parameter object Serialize (its vtable+0x10) when ConstructShaderParameters(frequency) returned one

typedList.layout: int32 count; per entry uint32, int32 handler index, then the handler Serialize (typedParameterHandlers[index])

manual: functions read by hand rather than by the automatic reader: FMaterialShader::Serialize 1435B4200, FLocalVertexFactory parameters 1441E5260, adjustor thunk 14302C5D0, Scaleform vertex shader 1438BB980, Scaleform fragment shader 1438BBA40 (walks the uniform table at [[this+0xC0]+0x10], 28 entries of 10 bytes: int16 location, int16 array size at +6, uint8 kind at +8), handler list func_14360BBE0
